safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that there were no known unwell contacts and no nausea/vomiting reduces completeness of the infectious/viral syndrome history and may slightly affect differential diagnosis and documentation quality, but it is unlikely to change immediate management in this presentation. The main impact is potential downstream inefficiency or unnecessary questioning rather than direct harm.
